description: A stupid and pointless fabric mod that adds a bucket of wet slop

mods.name: Bucket Of Wet Slop
mods.description: The world is in turmoil and people are in pain. Even still, we can take comfort in knowing that there is bucket of wet slop.

releases.notes:
- Re-enabled full functionality for singleplayer
	- A check to disable most functionality in singleplayer was added shortly before the first release
	- Now that it has been removed, I will be making the modrinth page public as well as mark this version as a stable release
- Updated gradle from version 8.2 to 8.3
- Updated dependencies
	- loom 1.3 -> 1.5
	- loader 0.14.22 -> 0.15.6
	- fabric-api 0.76.0 -> 0.77.0

[Jar file was compiled with github actions.](https://github.com/FrostBird347/Bucket-Of-Wet-Slop/actions/runs/8282736974)
